requirements.name: variation-stability
requirements.message:
Across a variation set's options, no prim that is present in two or more options
MAY change its prim **type** or its authored local **transform**. A variation MAY
only add or remove geometry leaves under a stable part prim.

examples.name: each option adds its own geometry child under a stable part Xform
a shared child changes type between options
the part's transform differs between options

requirements.name: collision-envelope-invariant
requirements.message:
Every option of a variation variant set that carries colliders MUST hold the
asset's collision envelope size invariant within tolerance.

examples.name: both collider options span the same collision envelope
a collider option resizes the collision envelope

requirements.name: conditional-presence
requirements.message:
A variation variant set MUST exist if and only if its scope offers two or more
options; a scope with a single representation carries no variant set.

examples.name: a multi-option part carries a set; a single-representation part does not
a variant set with a single option

requirements.name: option-composability
requirements.message:
Every option of a variation variant set MUST compose to a valid stage, and the
category's content requirements MUST hold under **each** option, not only under
the authored default.

examples.name: each option composes its own non-empty content

requirements.name: impact-class-honesty
requirements.message:
A variant set's declared `impactClass` MUST match what its options actually
change: a `visual-only` set changes no simulation-relevant data; a
`simulation-affecting` set changes only the domain it declares.

examples.name: a visual-only set changes only visual data

requirements.name: variation-discovery-metadata
requirements.message:
Every advertised variation variant set MUST be declared under
`customLayerData.SimReady_Metadata.Variants.<Category>.<VariantSetName>` with its
owning prim, category, default option, and impact class.

requirements.name: section-purity-isolation
requirements.message:
A per-part variation option MUST compose its content only through an isolated
payload arc, and selecting one option MUST NOT change any content outside that
part. A master option MUST author child variant selections only.

examples.name: per-part options compose only through a payload; the master authors only selections
a per-part option inlines its content

requirements.name: variant-set-location
requirements.message:
A variation variant set MUST live on the asset's default (root) prim, declare at
least two options, and author a valid default selection that names one of those
options.

requirements.name: visual-envelope-invariant
requirements.message:
Every option of a variation variant set MUST hold the asset's visual envelope
size invariant within tolerance.

examples.name: both options occupy the same visual envelope
an option resizes the visual envelope

requirements.name: authored-physical-properties
requirements.message:
An asset with a `Collision` variation MUST author its mass, center of mass, and
inertia explicitly with `UsdPhysics.MassAPI`, and those values MUST be identical
across every collider option.
